reason: Counted capsules in a sachet means no more half-used bottle sitting in my drawer, and at $24.99 with the money-back guarantee I would try one box if a creator video showed it helping with sleep. I would not pay full price on a whim.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a drawer full of supplements I stopped taking, so I worry this becomes another one I quit after a week.
